_meta.description: Third-declension feminine nouns with a competing instrumental-plural form: neutral -ями vs stylistically marked -(ь)ми (Rozental §155). Default direction corrupts the neutral -ями form into the marked -ьми form (дверями -> дверьми). 'кость' is idiom_reversed: -ьми is itself the norm inside the fixed idiom 'лечь костьми', so there the corruption goes the other way (-ьми -> -ями) when one of idiom_triggers immediately precedes the noun; outside that context 'кость' follows the default direction (-ями -> -ьми).
_meta.source: manual curation; Rozental grammar tradition (§155 instrumental plural variants)
_meta.note: Pruned 2026-07-07 (audit): дверьми/лошадьми/дочерьми/плетьми are fully normative variants (gramota), so corrupting to them creates no error. Only the idiom-gated кость case survives: лечь костьми requires -ьми, so костьми→костями inside the idiom is a real error.
